title: pi-turn-classify configuration
description: Classify each finished agent turn with a decision model

enabled.description: Classify turns. Off by default: it is opt-in network traffic.

endpoint.description: Decision server base URL. A trailing /v1 is accepted.

model.description: Model id as the server knows it (e.g. vllm-sr/d3-lite, Cloudflare/clef-flash).

api.description: systemone = TypeSafe/Jeff /v1/systemone; decisions = OpenAI Decisions API /v1/decisions.

apiKey.description: Optional bearer token, e.g. an EAVS virtual key.

timeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout. A timeout is reported, never retried in the turn path.

instructions.description: auto omits question instructions for D3 checkpoints, which reject them with 400.

confidenceFloor.description: Choice answers below this confidence render as 'unclear' on the card.

statusLine.description: Show the latest card in the TUI status line.

projects.description: Known projects for the 'which project' question. Derived from cwd and git remotes when omitted.

hint.description: Extra steer for the model: path, remote, or what the project is.

dataset.description: Optional background corpus: append every finished turn (digest + model answers + error) to a JSONL file so a calibration set builds itself.
